reviews.text: The staff were very friendly and reassuring and they took great care of my pet.

Thank you so much, dear David, Frankie, Grant and the whole team for another professional and kind care of Archie during and after his surgery. Thank you for spotting and removing cancer when there were no signs of it and for thorough ultrasound examination… grateful, as always, for all these 13.5 years that you’ve been looking after him! Wishing all the pet owners to have vets like David next to them, so they could enjoy as many years with their pets with energy and interest as possible ❤️🙏

Very professional and empathetic staff towards my pets.
Strongly recommend it !!
I found all the staff very friendly and helpful , seen on time and vet was very good with my anxious dog.
Great experience. We needed some special help and Leo was super responsive and kind. The team were great and we got what we needed with no fuss.
Great. Service. Friendly staff.
A pleasant experience- positive and thorough examination with plenty of supportive advice from the vet who allowed time for questions and discussion on next steps.
Really happy with the care and service at Medivet Cross Street. The team are friendly, caring and professional, and always make you feel that your pet is in safe hands. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️
Yearly booster vaccin for my cat

Arriving at Medivet Cross St is always a welcome relief after the struggle to get my big strong panic-stricken cat into the carrier and finding a taxi service that will take us. Kind, welcoming and professional staff. But no one has ever managed to get a pill into my cat's mouth: I suggest that a pack of Lickylix be available in each surgery!.

I returned back to medivets Islington after having an awful experience with another vet. Toby has been in the best care here and it was lovely to be back and get Toby seen treated with care and patience. Dr David and staff are excellent, I can’t recommend them enough. Going to other vets for cheaper treatment it’s not an option , lesson learned.

My dog sunnie had grass seed, logged in his paw. So had to be sedated to get it removed. £800! One of the fees being having to hold him in. He “went in for the surgery”at 9am. I called at 1:20 to see when he could be picked up. To hear they haven’t started on him. My dog has a very soft temperament and hates being in kennels. This was never once brought to my attention, that he would be stuck in a kennel all day. Whilst on the phone the staff was very rude and dismissive. I don’t see why it should be a fee to keep my dog in a kennel all day when I had already voiced that I’m not at work so can bring him in at any time and pick him up at anytime. It’s all about money for most of these vets. It’s so sad to see.
lovely lovely staff who take great care of animals!!

Good veterinary clinic, my Annie goes there with confidence, she loves the vet and the receptionist. We attended the Cross street and she was seeing by the vet as an emergency. Thank you for kindness.

We visited Medivet- and was seen by Dr Rubiera- an excellent vet! With brilliant expertise and great patient care ( vet as owners!).
I highly recommend the practice.

Amazing as always David & all staff extremely welcoming & very friendly Dex & Nala enjoy there visits Cross Streets Dr Doolittle
Thank you everyone

David Rubiera is an AMAZING vet! I would absolutely recommend his expertise and knowledge. 5 stars!
He is an absolutely amazing vet.

Always helpful. Really happy with these vets. Receptionists are kind and knowledgable. The vets are great - they look after my dog and cat so well. This time, my beagle had various symptoms including diarrhoea - I was given practical advice for managing it and clear instructions for what to do next if she doesn’t improve.
All people here are kind and competent, I am very happy that my cat and my dog receive good care. Thank you for your hard work.
Good, compassionate care

i brought benjy in on the day of his annual check up
the receptionist was friendly and helpful
the vet was caring and helpful and loved benjy
i was charged a fair price for the visit.
thank you medivet for the day
well done.
ps. keep up the good customer service.
thank you.
they tend to overcharge
Great vet clinic! Always super attentive and helpful :)
very efficient and quickly done jabs for my dog covered by the monthly plan

So disappointed! They operated on my dog at 15 and he just got worse. I had to lay him to rest. I am still paying off his bill as I had to pay in instalments because I could not afford the total amount. I am heartbroken. This was with MEDIVETS ! I AM UTTERLY DISGUSTED ! They take advantage of people because we will do anything to help our pets and I get the feeling that all they are interested  in is money. I am in the process of writing  to the C.E.O. I dont want to continue paying this debt when my poor dog is no longer here. Please do yourself a favor and dont use MEDIVETS! I really believe they will paint you a picture that your dog will be fine so they can continue robbing you when really your pet will never truly recover. I feel like I have been scammed!
Lovely caring staff - my dog Bella is always well looked after and it's a relief!
Excellent veterinary practice, always kind and friendly expert staff, wonderful with our dog :)

This practice have been caring for our 11 year old Cockapoo since she was a puppy.  I have absolute faith and trust in David (vet) and Grace (vet) and could not recommend them highly enough.  All the staff are welcoming, caring and efficient.
Thankful to Dr. David Rubiera for always going the extra mile.
Lovely staff all very pleasant and helpful with the care of the new addition to my cat family

Highly recommend Medivet Cross street enough. Especially Doctor David who caught my cat's cogenital diaphragmatic hernia through an ultrasound and helped us manage a referral for her surgery which saved her life. Super grateful to him, nurse Bianca and the entire team there who helped with Harley's case. They are always friendly, helpful and responsive. The exact type of people you want looking after your pets. Cannot thank them enough.
Thank you for rating us. Your feedback is really appreciated.

Great welcome at reception. The vet was kind and practical. I particularly appreciated she did not try to "up sell". She recognised Gen is healthy and well cared for so additional treatments, especially dental, would be superfluous.

My dog had an accident and they fitted me in within ten minutes and supported me through a tough time.

They looked after and cared for my dog and the cost was very satisfactory.

Thank you to all the team here.
David the lead Vet is fabulous.  Such a professional.  An absolute walking encyclopedia who shares his knowledge of dogs and their health in a clear easy to understand manner.
Great Vet, very friendly, helpful and lovely! Highly recommend them! Thank you x

All the vets seemed friendly, booking an appointment is easy via the website and when I emailed them with concerns about our cats, they always responded quickly and helpfully. I didn't get the impression they were in it for the money - they seemed to genuinely care about our cats and want the best for them.
David and the Cross Street team are professional and friendly, understanding pet parents’ anxiety when our fur babies aren’t well. A highly recommended practice.
Lovely practice with equally lovely and caring staff.

I switched from Finsbury Park Medivet to Islington. In my first visit they were already trying to sell me treatments for my cat for random tests or dental work that the Finsbury Park clinic never tried. Then talked me into a monthly Medivet subscription with the benefit of regular deworming and flea treatment.

When I called to get a top up of treatments, they said I would be notified when it’s ready for pick up and no one ever got back to me. Apparently someone left me a voicemail telling me I have to take my cat into the vet to weight her again. Completely unreasonable to expect people to take time off work just to take their pet in to weigh in to get the treatments I’m supposed to get for free from my plan. The whole Medivet insurance is a scam they don’t actually give the benefits they promised or expects you to jump through hoops to get it. DO NOT SIGN UP

The vets are knowledgeable, friendly and genuinely caring. I took my senior dog and my senior cat to have their check-ups and vaccinations and both Tess and Grace made us feel welcome and comfortable. Thank you to the team, looking forward to continuing to bring our beloved pets to a place they are well looked after.

Everyone is really kind, friendly and helpful. They will find you an appointment if it's urgent. We've used them for years in my family and haven't had a bad experience so far. They were lovely when we had to say bye to my mum's dog too and send a really sweet card which was a kind gesture
Really caring vet. I recommend this practice for your pet!
Knowledgable, supportive and very helpful for my dog’s export health certificate. Would highly recommend. Thank you all.
Managed to fit my in last minute hence the rating. Looked after my cat well but it’s expensive.
Registered two new kittens,. Could not have been more helpful - highly recommend.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Best vet I’ve been to so far. Such great care and attention to detail. Couldn’t recommend more!

The staff are all wonderful. My cat, Jet, is extremely nervous about visits and leaving home. I had to reschedule thirty minutes before my appointment as she was so distressed. When I called, I was met with understanding and empathetic ears. I was even given tips on how to get her in the carrier for the rescheduled visit. Great friendly staff.
Always friendly, helpful, and compassionate
Thank you for rating us. Your feedback is really appreciated.
David and staff are always very helpful and give you a warm welcome and I wouldn’t take my pugs anywhere else

Vets have great expertise and really do their jobs thoroughly explaining matters to owners and why particular  tests might need to be conducted. Take time to get to know pets which is great and relaxes animals.This was Lola in the corner on first trip but now she is happy to be on the vet’s examination table.
Cat had to have some teeth extracted. The staff were kind, helpful and communicated well. They have a knack of making a frightened pet feel comfortable. Recommend this practice.
David and his team are caring,kind and very thorough when my dog is unwell. I would highly recommend Medivet.
They are great with my cat and offer great insights to all my qiestions.

I would like to thank David and his team of nurses for all the care they have given my cats Barney and Abbie. Nothing is too much trouble, if I have a problem or are worried about anything they are always able to put my mind at rest or if necessary ask me to bring my cat in to sort out the problem. Sadly Barney passed away 18 months ago after a long illness but I cannot fault the care and love they gave him to make his last weeks as comfortable as possible. David is an extremely knowledgeable and compassionate vet who really cares about his patients and their owners and he is supported by an excellent team of nurses who are always welcoming and helpful whenever you visit or call the clinic. Once again thank you 🐱
Professional service, caring and animal loving staff.

An amazing team of people who are understanding and caring. I was desperate for an appointment, my usual branch didn’t have any as I had missed the appointment due to being stuck in traffic, but my poor cat had a wound under his neck and needed to be seen. Receptionist was swift to find the same day appointment for us.
Vet Grace was absolutely fantastic and understanding, she and the nurse working the shift with her took great care of my cat ( he’s not a great fan of the vets and gets into his tiger mode). Grace suggested the best way for me to treat my poorly cat at home? understood my financial situation and why I opted for a home care option rather than having him treated at the vets for a few days. Keeping in touch with the surgery via email and sending them pictures with updates of the wound gave me assurance that everything will be okay.
Thank you team!❤️

Definitely recommend signing up with this branch if you haven’t already!
Great vets practice, I recently moved around an hour away and still make the effort to bring my dog to this specific branch due to it being so good.

I had been with medivet for 10 year and with Cross Street branch at least 7years. I had to take my cats abroad with me since I moved for work. David was super helpful with the paperwork. Also he prioritized my bookings to speed up the time …
